projects.name: urban_heat_islands
projects.title: Urban Heat Island (UHI) AI Mitigation & Satellite Analysis Platform (Vercel Cloud)

interactions.description: 1. Overview: Highlight Platform Header & Research Framework
2. Overview: Inspect Noida Sector-106 Problem Framing & Pipeline Diagram
3. Overview: Scroll Back to Navigation Bar
4. Tab 2: Switch to Satellite Vision
5. Satellite Vision: Execute U-Net Semantic Segmentation Inference
6. Satellite Vision: Inspect Predicted Land-Cover Mask Layer
7. Satellite Vision: Switch to Multi-Spectral Blended Overlay View
8. Satellite Vision: Inspect Raw High-Resolution Optical Scene
9. Tab 3: Switch to 3D Digital Twin
10. 3D Digital Twin: Project 3D Thermal Heat Dome Relief
11. 3D Digital Twin: Simulate 3D Spatial Counterfactual Greening
12. 3D Digital Twin: Drape Satellite Imagery onto 3D Mesh
13. 3D Digital Twin: Toggle Isometric 3D Elevation Perspective
14. 3D Digital Twin: Scale Building & Terrain Extrusion Height to 2.3x
15. 3D Digital Twin: Activate Cinematic 3D Camera Orbit Auto-Rotation
16. Tab 4: Switch to Thermal Predictor (LST Regression)
17. Thermal Predictor: Adjust Solar Radiation Forcing to 850 W/m²
18. Thermal Predictor: Adjust Humidity to 65% and Observe ANN LST Forecast
19. Tab 5: Switch to Mitigation Simulator
20. Mitigation Simulator: Ramp Greening Target to 35% Intervention
21. Mitigation Simulator: Analyze Cooling Delta Curves & Energy Reduction
22. Mitigation Simulator: Scroll back to Navigation
23. Tab 6: Switch to Model Verification & Benchmark Analytics
24. Model Analytics: Inspect U-Net & Regression ANN Training Convergence and Test Confusion Matrix
25. Model Analytics: Scroll back up
26. Tab 7: Switch to Geospatial Grid-Cell Aggregation
27. Geospatial Grid: Compute Micro-Climate Clustering & Zonal Statistics
28. Wrap-Up: Return to Main Overview Dashboard
